title: Prompt Lottery in LLM-as-a-Judge: Measuring and Mitigating Sensitivity to Syntactic Rephrasing
abstract: arXiv:2610.38076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a standard for evaluating large language models, yet most approaches implicitly assume that a single judge prompt functions as a stable evaluation instrument. Prior work has primarily explored deliberate prompt modifications such as scoring rubrics, role descriptions, or chain-of-thought reasoning in order to optimize accuracy. In contrast, we investigate whether validated prompt variants intended to preserve evaluation semantics while differing in surface realization (\textit{paraphrastic rephrasings}) yield consistent judgments under a fixed evaluation task. We introduce \textit{Prompt Lottery}, a phenomenon in which paraphrastic rephrasings produce different LLMaJ judgments. Across a large-scale study spanning diverse evaluation tasks, judge families, and model backbones, we find that these variations can alter evaluation outcomes and, in some settings, reverse relative model rankings. translated_title: LLM-as-a-Judge中的提示彩票现象：测量与缓解对句法改写的敏感性
translated_abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge已成为评估大语言模型的标准方法，然而大多数方法都隐含地假设单个评判提示词是一个稳定的评估工具。以往的工作主要探索有意的提示词修改，例如评分标准、角色描述或思维链推理，以优化评估准确性。与此相反，我们研究的是那些经过验证、旨在保持评估语义不变但表面表述存在差异的提示词变体（即释义性改写），是否在固定评估任务下仍能产生一致的判断。我们提出了“提示彩票”这一现象，即释义性改写会导致LLM-as-a-Judge产生不同的评判结果。在一项涵盖多样化评估任务、评判模型家族和底层模型的大规模研究中，我们发现这些表面变化能够改变评估结果，在某些设置下甚至会颠倒模型之间的相对排名。一项针对10名用户的…（摘要截断）
tldr: 论文发现了“提示彩票”现象——语义等价的提示词改写会导致LLM-as-a-Judge产生不一致的评判结果，甚至可能逆转模型的相对排名，并提出了测量与缓解这种句法改写敏感性的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "Prompt Lottery" phenomenon, where semantically equivalent paraphrased judge prompts produce inconsistent LLM-as-a-Judge judgments that can even reverse relative model rankings, and proposes methods to measure and mitigate this sensitivity to syntactic rephrasing.
